fusions.name: Snagging Clip
fusions.desc: Flicks a barbed clip into the first enemy it meets that deals 6 damage, with a 15% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1 second. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Cliffhanger Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 6-tile line of barbed pages ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Catching Clasp
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Reader
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
